---
name: Skill request
about: A skill you want evaluated, or one you would share with everyone
labels: enhancement
---

## The skill

What it is for, and what it would do for someone who installed it.

## Have you written it?

- [ ] I have a working skill and I would share it
- [ ] I want one and I do not have it yet

If you have it, link it or paste the `SKILL.md` frontmatter.

## What you want from it

- [ ] An eval: I want to see whether it actually helps
- [ ] Sharing: I want other people to be able to install it

## How you would know it worked

The kind of task it should improve, and what a better answer would look like. This is what an eval measures.
